name: More
address: 12 Kings Way, Leisure Isle, Knysna, 6571, South Africa
description_short: Island cafe and gallery on Leisure Isle serving sushi, fish and chips, pizza, and coffee with local art displays.
description_long:
More sits on Leisure Isle's Kings Way, combining a relaxed cafe with an art gallery showcasing local work. The menu covers plenty of ground — from fresh sushi rolls and classic fish and chips to wood-fired pizzas and proper coffee. It's the kind of spot where you can grab a quick takeaway or settle in for a lazy afternoon browsing art between bites.

The island location gives it a laid-back, off-the-beaten-track feel, popular with locals and visitors who've discovered this quiet corner of Knysna. Whether you're after a light lunch, something sweet from the dessert counter, or just a coffee while admiring the gallery pieces, More offers an easygoing mix that works any time of day.
